name: cloudflare-fullstack-template
description: Production-ready fullstack template for Cloudflare Workers + Pages

scripts.build: bun run --filter shared build && bun run --filter backend build
scripts.type-check: bun run --filter shared type-check && bun run --filter backend type-check
scripts.clean: bun run --filter backend clean && bun run --filter shared clean
scripts.install:all: bun install && bun install --filter backend && bun install --filter shared
